{{Infobox character|name=Aunt Merida|house=[[House Blackcrest]]|role=Elder; former keeper of the Chronicle|age=~74}}
'''Aunt Merida''' kept the [[Chronicle of Victory]] before the present line, and is now withdrawn, and considered confused. She drops fragments — a name, a number, a line of verse — found in no official source. Whether she remembers what the record lost, or is conflating centuries of stories she herself once wrote, no one can say. Not even her.
